note: Hand-labelled prompts for the Stage 6 heuristic and Stage 7 classifier. `label` is the ground truth: would this prompt be answered wrongly if fired without waiting for the previous answer? Judgement calls are recorded in `why`. Stage 11 grows this set and formalises the scoring.

labels.dependent: needs the previous answer's content to be answerable
labels.independent: self-contained; the previous answer adds nothing it needs
